Cargo.toml.text:
[package]
name = "nextcore-core"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[features]
default = ["std", "macho"]
std = ["dep:plist", "dep:serde", "dep:thiserror", "dep:log"]
macho = ["std", "dep:goblin"]

[dependencies]
plist = { version = "1.10", optional = true }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"], optional = true }
goblin = { version = "0.10", default-features = false, features = ["mach64", "alloc"], optional = true }
thiserror = { version = "2", default-features = false, optional = true }
log = { version = "0.4", optional = true }
roxmltree = { version = "=0.21.1", default-features = false }

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json = "1"

[[example]]
name = "inspect_kc"
required-features = ["std"]

[[example]]
name = "stage_kc"
required-features = ["std"]

[[example]]
name = "audit_kc"
required-features = ["std"]

[[example]]
name = "rebase_kc"
required-features = ["std"]

[[test]]
name = "acpi_parse"
required-features = ["std"]
[[test]]
name = "config_parse"
required-features = ["std"]
[[test]]
name = "config_roundtrip"
required-features = ["std"]
[[test]]
name = "device_props"
required-features = ["std"]
[[test]]
name = "handoff_roundtrip"
required-features = ["std"]
[[test]]
name = "kext_scan"
required-features = ["std"]
[[test]]
name = "mach_o_load"
required-features = ["macho"]
